strongest_rejected_alternative: Taking 12:5-12:13 as one unit of nine verses was the main rival. It was declined because the PE after 12:8 and the speaker change at 12:9 coincide, and the seer's report of hearing and not understanding closes the scene he began at 12:5 (INFERRED). A cut at 12:6/12:7 would split question and oath (INFERRED). A nearer rival is a seam at 12:7/12:8, which would keep the seer's question at 12:8 together with the answer it receives at 12:9 (INFERRED). On the present seam the speech verb stands at the head of oshb:Dan.12.9 and the PE after 12:8 is a single-witness mark (EXTRACTED, OSHB/WLC and OSHB mark layer). That verb is a weak connective, which opens no unit by itself, so the seam rests neither on it nor on the mark alone (INFERRED). The seam is kept because the question of 12:8 follows from the seer's hearing of the oath at 12:7 and so belongs to the scene of 12:5-12:8, while the reply carries the time-of-the-end phrase and continues to the close of the book (INFERRED).
